results.name: S1  HTTPS redirect script is the first script in <head>
S2  CSP meta present with object-src none, base-uri self, upgrade-insecure-requests
S3  CSP connect-src is limited to own origin + the Supabase project
S4  every err message rendered into HTML goes through esc()
S5  hard-coded demo OTP removed
S6  no Math.random left for OTP / ids
S7  password hash is PBKDF2 (no unsalted SHA-256, no base64 fallback)
S8  legacy local login no longer auto-creates accounts
S9  vault key is never written to localStorage (no 'k:' / 's:' session payload)
S10 no direct-table upsert fallback and no local_ account creation in auth code
S11 service worker never caches cross-origin / authenticated requests
S12 Edge Functions: JWT verified, rate limited, CORS allow-list (no wildcard)
S13 Edge Functions pin supabase-js to an exact version
S14 SQL: RLS on, rate-limit fn is SECURITY DEFINER with empty search_path, no anon/PUBLIC grants
S15 SQL: parameterised only (no EXECUTE / dynamic SQL anywhere in migrations)
S16 no raw SQL string building in frontend or functions
S17 auth config: min password 12, confirmations on, signups rate limited, anon off
S18 no admin routes / pages / debug flags exist
S19 no secret/service-role keys or JWTs in shipped files (only the public publishable key)
S20 Postgres best-practices migration adds indexes and initPlan-cached auth.uid()
S21 client caches public emergency storage and parallelizes independent async work
S22 Settings CSS enforces media-scoped light theme, focus-visible ring, and reduced-motion rule
S23 All UI copy is gender-neutral (no feminine-only address across HTML/JS)
S24 User routes table enforces RLS, (select auth.uid()) initPlan, and revokes direct anon/public SELECT
S25 authorize-route Edge Function middleware verifies JWT, enforces rate limiting, and blocks IDOR access
S26 Clean URL router (404.html + IDCAuthMiddleware) resolves /IDC/<id> and enforces anti-IDOR authorization
S27 First-time setup & NFC studio auto-generate personal URL + QR code and render step-by-step NFC programming guide
S28 LinkedIn, custom user links, and Bank Accounts (IBAN / InstaPay) are supported across profile and vault
S29 speed-engineer Images & Loading UX: WebP compression, lazy/fetchpriority attributes, .sk Skeleton loader, and auth pending state
S30 speed-engineer Pagination & Caching: 20-item page size with load-more and in-memory vault/bundle caches
S31 web-design-guidelines: label-for binding, aria-live polite, touch-action manipulation, overscroll-behavior contain, preconnect, and ellipsis in 404.html
S32 supabase-postgres-best-practices: storage.objects 200-file RLS check filters on indexed owner = (select auth.uid())
S33 speed-engineer profile persisted in AGENTS.md with Tier S and speed-engineer trigger rule
S34 writing-guidelines: SECURITY.md, SETUP.md, and README.md are 100% gender-neutral and document authorize-route
S35 Emergency SOS button sends GPS location + emergency profile and works offline
S36 Private partition supports Duress PIN (decoy vault without decrypting real vault)
S37 Card Bank implements spending limit (linear bar + 80% warn + block), hide balance (10s auto-rehide + biometric), 5 categories breakdown, and <=30d expiry alert
S38 Direct LinkedIn flow normalizes HTTPS profile URLs and opens saved LinkedIn profile directly
S39 Hourly Temporary Share (#s=...) supports 4/7/24h + custom hours and CV/Profile/Both scopes
E1  allowed origin gets CORS header, no wildcard
E2  foreign origin is rejected with 403
E3  non-POST rejected with 405
E4  preflight returns 204
E5  no ALLOWED_ORIGINS configured => browser requests fail closed (503)
E6  rate limit: RPC false => limited
E7  rate limit: RPC error => fails closed
T1  sign-up with a short password is rejected client-side (no API call)
T1b password without digits rejected
T1c password containing the e-mail name rejected
T2  sign-up without confirmed e-mail opens no vault and writes no local vault/session
T3a legacy session containing the vault key is deleted on load
T3b login succeeds and opens the home screen
T3c derived vault key is NOT present anywhere in localStorage
T3d only ciphertext+salt were sent to the Edge Function, never the key or plaintext
T3e sign-out clears cached ciphertext and session
T4a (setup) a cached local vault exists on the device
T4b with the server refusing the login, the cached local vault does NOT let anyone in
T4c network failure during login is handled (no crash, no entry)
T5  when secure-vault fails there is no direct idc_vaults upsert fallback
T6  tampered vault rejected: path traversal in attachment
T6  tampered vault rejected: script-injection id
T7  after 5 bad logins the client stops calling the API (back-off active)
T8  page reload with a stored Supabase session shows the lock screen (key not recoverable)
T8b sign-out in another tab wipes in-memory state
T9a owner accessing their own route (/IDC/1111) is authorized as owner
T9b changing URL ID to another user's route (/IDC/2222) is blocked by IDOR middleware (403)
T9c blocked IDOR attempt never leaks the current user's vault or grants owner access to route 2222
T10a idcNormalizeHttpsUrl normalizes linkedin.com/in/... to https://
T10b idcNormalizeHttpsUrl blocks javascript:, data:, http:, and blank URLs
T10c idcOpenLinkedIn prompts when unset and opens saved LinkedIn directly via noopener
T11a 4-hour CV link includes public CV items and excludes private/secret items, full NID, and base64 photos
T11b scope isolation (profile vs cv vs both) and 7h/24h/clamped durations work accurately
T11c temporary share link expires automatically right after hours elapse
T11d expired/corrupted #s=... link fails closed and renders expiry screen with zero leaked data
